An '''''Imperial''-class Star Destroyer''' [[Captain/Legends|captained]] by [[Dirk Balor]] was patrolling the [[Lapez system/Legends|Lapez system]] in [[3 ABY/Legends|3 ABY]]. The [[Human replica droid]] [[Altin Wuho]] and his [[nightmare demon]] [[Reist]] were stationed aboard the ship.
